activities.caption: pair each rendering with the skopos that shaped it
activities.name: tviSkoposMatch

config.prompt: The same German line under three briefs — pair each target text with the purpose that shaped it:

pairs.left: "The report must be submitted by Friday"
pairs.right: a legal document: obligation preserved exactly, even where it reads stiffly

pairs.left: "Could you make sure I have the report by Friday?"
pairs.right: a business email: get the report, politely
a novel's general: the command effect
stay close to the original's form and structure
reproduce the effect on the reader

config.why: Three faithful renderings of "Der Bericht muss bis Freitag vorliegen" — the translator's first skill is asking what this job is for, because the purpose (Vermeer's skopos, 1978) decides the strategy, not the tokens.

activities.caption: find the line the literalism-myth would love
activities.name: tviLiteralSpot

config.prompt: One line of this summary is the literalism-myth speaking — click it:
lines: Fidelity is to meaning and effect, not to tokens.
The most faithful job is the most literal one — word-for-word, structure preserved.
Rendered literally, an idiom buries its own sense.
A legal line split to mirror German word order can end up asserting something the original does not.
Word-for-word is not the safety default but one more choice.
config.correction: Literal is not the default; the purpose decides — and literalism usually loses.
config.why: Each of the three renderings of "Der Bericht muss bis Freitag vorliegen" is faithful to a purpose; none is faithful to the words alone.

activities.caption: drag the divider — smooth it out, or keep the strangeness
activities.name: tviVenutiCompare

config.prompt: The culture-level choice — drag the divider:

before.label: Domestication: smooth into the target culture
before.text: Translate the Japanese -san as Mr or Ms, rename foods, normalise word order — the translator rendered invisible. A global thriller probably wants this.

after.label: Foreignisation: keep the strangeness visible
after.text: Keep sensei, the honorifics, the syntax rhythms — readers feel they are reading something from elsewhere. A scholarly edition of The Tale of Genji may want heavy doses.

config.why: The choice is ideological — smoothing quietly makes the other culture fluent in ours — which is why literary work debates it openly, and why a manga series lives from the tension between the two. Localisation for products adapts formats, currencies and jokes wholesale.

activities.caption: line up the five escapes by intervention
activities.name: tviEscapesOrder

config.prompt: Five ways past the untranslatable — drag them from least to most intervention:
items: borrowing — import the word (schadenfreude, saudade have entered English)
calque — translate the parts ("flea market" from marché aux puces)
substitution — a target-culture effect in place of the original (a different pun)
explanation — keep it and add a gloss
omission or compensation — drop it here, add wordplay elsewhere
config.why: Rising order of intervention — every choice loses something, and the craft is choosing deliberately what to lose, then defending the loss.

activities.anchor: one of the most extreme routine cognitive loads
activities.caption: call the booth's lag
activities.name: tviSpanEstimate

config.prompt: Live in the booth: how far behind the speaker does a simultaneous interpreter's ear-voice span run?
config.why: Two to four seconds — and with listening-and-analysis, memory and production sharing one working memory (Gile's effort model), interpreters work 20–30-minute shifts in pairs; numbers and idioms cause the classic failures because they are long, low-redundancy chunks that cannot be paraphrased safely.
config.context: Consecutive is a different performance: Rozan's verticality notes plus trained memory for sense, not words.

activities.caption: file each text by who leads after neural MT
activities.name: tviMtBuckets

config.prompt: After neural MT — file each text type by who leads:
config.why: Machines fail exactly where professionals add value: register consistency, culture-bound reference, implicit meaning, accountability — a mistranslated dosage has a liable human name on it. Literary MT stays reliably tone-deaf: fluent sentences, wrong book.

activities.caption: commit to a rendering, then defend the loss
activities.name: tviHaikuBranch

config.root: A publisher hands you furuike ya / kawazu tobikomu / mizu no oto — old pond / frog jumps-in / water's sound — and asks for an English page. You must choose a rendering and defend it.

start.text: Which rendering do you commit to?

choices.label: Literal: "The old pond — / a frog leaps in, / the sound of water"
choices.feedback: You keep the thirteen-beat structure, the cutting word ya's pause, and the event as discovered rather than composed.

choices.label: Domesticated: "stillness — the frog startles the pond awake"
choices.feedback: You gain immediacy — and lose the objectivity that makes the original feel found, not written.

literal.text: Your cost: the risk of flatness, traded for fidelity.

choices.label: State the priority order in the brief
choices.feedback: Image, rhythm, register, form — declared and defended consistently.

dom.text: Your cost: paraphrase, traded for effect.

choices.label: State the priority order in the brief
choices.feedback: Image, rhythm, register, form — declared and defended consistently.

end.text: Both renderings are defensible; each sacrifices differently. The sin is not any single loss, but unexamined, shifting losses.

config.why: Scale the same choices up and you have literary work's whole economy: rhythm versus sense, strangeness versus fluency, the poem the author wrote versus the poem the reader would have had.

activities.anchor: Professional quality is managed, not inspired
activities.caption: fill the pipeline's first and last guard-rails
activities.name: tviFlowCloze

config.text: The sequence runs %%brief%% → draft → revision → proof; the draft is for sense, the separate revision pass is for the target language, the proof is mechanical. Score the result against the error taxonomy — accuracy, terminology, register/style — and let back-translation stay a %%diagnostic%%, never the grade.
config.hint: The skopos made operational opens the pipeline; and back-translation flags ambiguities without measuring anything.
